scope: Actual community handlers/components and communities-db friendship-bearing SQL builders. A local pg provider rejects generated queries referencing friendships with a permission Error; it does not execute those SQL statements. Other DB/profile/domain dependencies are local fixtures. Anonymous paths omit the relationship CTE; community request aggregation performs no relationship read.

trace.text:
WITH user_friends AS (SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN f.address_requester = $1 
      THEN f.address_requested
      ELSE f.address_requester
    END as address, created_at
  FROM friendships f
  WHERE f.is_active = true
    AND (
      f.address_requester = $2
      OR f.address_requested = $3
    )), 
communities_with_members_count AS (
    SELECT c.id, COUNT(cm.member_address) as "membersCount"
    FROM communities c
    LEFT JOIN community_members cm ON c.id = cm.community_id
    WHERE c.active = true
   GROUP BY c.id), 
community_friends AS (
        SELECT 
          c.id as community_id,
          (
            SELECT array_agg(address ORDER BY address)
            FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT uf.address
              FROM user_friends uf
              JOIN community_members cm ON cm.member_address = uf.address
              WHERE cm.community_id = c.id
              LIMIT 3
            ) subq
          ) as friends
        FROM communities c
        WHERE c.active = true
      )

        SELECT 
          c.id,
          c.name,
          c.description,
          c.owner_address as "ownerAddress",
          COALESCE(cm.role, $4) as role,
          CASE WHEN c.private THEN 'private' ELSE 'public' END as privacy,
          CASE WHEN c.unlisted THEN 'unlisted' ELSE 'all' END as visibility,
          c.active,
          cwmc."membersCount",
          COALESCE(cf.friends, ARRAY[]::text[]) as friends
        FROM communities c
         LEFT  JOIN community_members cm ON c.id = cm.community_id AND cm.member_address = $5
        LEFT JOIN communities_with_members_count cwmc ON c.id = cwmc.id
        LEFT JOIN community_friends cf ON c.id = cf.community_id
        LEFT JOIN community_bans cb ON c.id = cb.community_id AND cb.banned_address = $6 AND cb.active = true
        WHERE c.active = true AND cb.banned_address IS NULL AND c.unlisted = false ORDER BY c.editors_choice DESC, c.ranking_score DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT $7 OFFSET $8
